verdict.rationale: Zero's official MCP server docs explicitly list 'Bulk delete emails' and 'Bulk archive emails' tools, so an AI agent can act on many emails at once. The evidence is a one-line bullet list and covers only delete and archive. Other operations such as mark read/unread and label changes are not described as bulk. missing for 10: bulk support for labeling, marking read and moving mail; documentation of batch size, selection by query and error handling; independent or hands-on corroboration.
